--List of accounts held by the customers (DEP, LNS, CCD, TRU, TRY)
--CTE is used to list the accounts per source of a customer
--Customers are filtered to CBC01
--Both Retail and Corporate customers are in the output
--x--Only non-closed accounts are considered--x--

WITH DEP AS
(
    SELECT
    AAS_AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,'DEP' AS SOURCE
    ,FORACID AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,ACCT_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME
    ,DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,BRANCH_NAME
    ,CASE WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 'Main'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 'Joint'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'Authorized Signatory'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'G' THEN 'Guarantor'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'Power of Attorney'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'L' THEN 'Letter of Authority'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'C' THEN 'Co-Obligant'
        ELSE 'Others' END ACCOUNT_HOLDER_TYPE
    ,ACCT_OPN_DATE AS OPENING_DATE
    ,ACCT_CLS_DATE AS CLOSING_DATE
    ,AREA
    ,REGION
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE AS PRODUCT_CODE
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE AS PRODUCT_APPLICATION
    ,YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP AS DEP_YTD_ADB_PHP
    ,OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP AS DEP_OUT_BAL_PHP
    ,0 AS LNS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS CCD_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS TRUST_FUND_VALUE
    ,0 AS TRY_OUTSTANDING_INVESTMENT
    FROM eds.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
    WHERE AAS_AS_OF_DATE IN (SELECT DEPOSITS_DATE FROM eds.EDS_CTL)
        AND AAS_DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
        AND AAS_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
        --AND (DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL)
        AND AAS_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
)
, LNS AS 
(
    SELECT
    AAS_AS_OF_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,ORGKEY AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,'LNS' AS SOURCE
    ,FORACID AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,ACCT_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME
    ,LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,BRANCH_NAME
    ,CASE WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 'Main'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 'Joint'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'A' THEN 'Authorized Signatory'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'G' THEN 'Guarantor'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'P' THEN 'Power of Attorney'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'L' THEN 'Letter of Authority'
        WHEN ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'C' THEN 'Co-Obligant'
        ELSE 'Others' END ACCOUNT_HOLDER_TYPE
    ,ACCT_OPN_DATE AS OPENING_DATE
    ,ACCT_CLS_DATE AS CLOSING_DATE
    ,AREA
    ,REGION
    ,GAM_SCHM_CODE PRODUCT_CODE
    ,GAM_SCHM_TYPE AS PRODUCT_APPLICATION
    ,0 AS DEP_YTD_ADB_PHP
    ,0 AS DEP_OUT_BAL_PHP
    ,RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP AS LNS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS CCD_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS TRUST_FUND_VALUE
    ,0 AS TRY_OUTSTANDING_INVESTMENT
    FROM eds.LOANS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
    WHERE AAS_AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT LOANS_DATE FROM eds.EDS_CTL)
        AND AAS_DEL_FLG <> 'Y'
        AND AAS_ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND GAM_ACID IS NOT NULL
        --AND (LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' AND LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS IS NOT NULL)
        AND AAS_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
)
, CCD AS 
(
    SELECT
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST_CIF_NBR AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,'CCD' AS SOURCE
    ,CRDACCT_NBR AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,NULL AS ACCOUNT_NAME
    ,CRDACCT_STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS BRANCH_NAME
    ,CARD_SUP_REL AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER_TYPE
    ,CAST(CAST(CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN AS CHAR(8)) AS DATE) AS OPENING_DATE
    ,CAST(CAST(CRDACCT_DTE_CLOSE AS CHAR(8)) AS DATE) AS CLOSING_DATE
    ,NULL AS AREA
    ,NULL AS REGION
    ,CAST(CRDACCT_PDT_NBR AS varchar(100)) AS PRODUCT_CODE
    ,'Credit Card' AS PRODUCT_APPLICATION
    ,0 AS DEP_YTD_ADB_PHP
    ,0 AS DEP_OUT_BAL_PHP
    ,0 AS LNS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,CASE WHEN COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL,0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL,0) >= 0 THEN COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL,0) + COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL,0)
        WHEN COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL,0) >= 0 AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL,0) < 0 THEN COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL,0)
        WHEN COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_BAL,0) < 0 AND COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL,0) >= 0 THEN COALESCE(CRDACCT_OUTSTD_INSTL,0)
        ELSE 0 END AS CCD_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS TRUST_FUND_VALUE
    ,0 AS TRY_OUTSTANDING_INVESTMENT
    FROM eds.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT
    WHERE AS_OF_DATE IN (SELECT CCD_DATE FROM eds.EDS_CTL)
        ---AND CRDACCT_STATUS <> 8
)
, TRU AS
(
    SELECT 
    (SELECT TRU_DATE FROM eds.EDS_CTL) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,CUST.UNIQUE_ID AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,'TRU' AS SOURCE
    ,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO AS ACCOUNT
    ,PORT.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME
    ,PORT.STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,PORT.SUB_BR_CD AS BRANCH_NAME
    ,CASE WHEN BASE.PRIMARY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Primary Holder'
        ELSE 'Non-Primary Holder' END ACCOUNT_HOLDER_TYPE
    ,PFSUB.INCEPTION_DATE AS OPENING_DATE
    ,NULL AS CLOSING_DATE
    ,NULL AS AREA
    ,NULL AS REGION
    ,PORT.PROD_CODE AS PRODUCT_CODE
    ,'Trust' AS PRODUCT_APPLICATION
    ,0 AS DEP_YTD_ADB_PHP
    ,0 AS DEP_OUT_BAL_PHP
    ,0 AS LNS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS CCD_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,(COALESCE(UITF.TOTAL_FUND_VALUE_IN_PHP,0) + COALESCE(NONUITF.AUM_IN_ORIG_CURR,0)) AS TRUST_FUND_VALUE
    ,0 AS TRY_OUTSTANDING_INVESTMENT
    FROM busc.TRU_CUST AS CUST
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_BASELINK AS BASE
            ON CUST.CUST_NO = BASE.CIF_NO
            AND BASE.ISLATEST = 1 AND BASE.ISACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_PORTFOLIO AS PORT
            ON BASE.CUST_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND PORT.ISLATEST = 1 AND PORT.ISACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION PFSUB
            ON PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = PFSUB.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
            AND PORT.BASE_NO = PFSUB.BASE_NO
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_AUMNONUITF AS NONUITF
            ON NONUITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND NONUITF.PF_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
            AND NONUITF.ISLATEST = 1 AND NONUITF.ISACTIVE = 1
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRU_AUMUITF AS UITF
            ON UITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
            AND UITF.PORTFOLIO_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
            AND UITF.ISLATEST = 1 AND UITF.ISACTIVE = 1
    WHERE CUST.ISACTIVE = 1 AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1
        AND PORT.STATUS = 'A'
)
, TRY_ACC AS
(
    SELECT
    LE.EXTERNAL_REF AS CIF_IDs,
    LE.ID AS TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,CASE
        WHEN TRADES.product_type LIKE 'Bond%' AND TRADES.book = 'Client' AND TRADES.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP' AND TRADES.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED'
        AND TRADES.maturity_date >  LEFT(RIGHT(TRADES.FILE_NAME,12),8) THEN 'Fixed Income Product Outstanding'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADES.BOOK in ('F_Intl_MM_Team1',  'F_Intl_MM_Team2',  'R_Dom_MM_Team1', 'R_Dom_MM_Team2', 'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing')
        AND TRADES.bundle_type <> 'PYA' AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Money Market Product Outstanding'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA'
        AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%' AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 'Structured Product PYA Outstanding'
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%' AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP' AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' AND TRADES.MATURITY_DATE > LEFT(RIGHT(TRADES.FILE_NAME,12),8) THEN 'Structured Product Asset Swap'
        END AS BALANCE_TYPE
    , CONVERT(datetime, CONVERT(varchar,LEFT(RIGHT(TRADES.FILE_NAME,12),8)))AS [TIMESTAMP]
    ,CASE
        WHEN TRADES.product_type LIKE 'Bond%' AND TRADES.book = 'Client' AND TRADES.bundle_type <> 'ASSET SWAP' AND TRADES.tradestatus = 'VERIFIED'
        AND TRADES.maturity_date >  LEFT(RIGHT(TRADES.FILE_NAME,12),8) THEN TRADES.NOMINAL
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADES.BOOK in ('F_Intl_MM_Team1',  'F_Intl_MM_Team2',  'R_Dom_MM_Team1', 'R_Dom_MM_Team2', 'R_Dom_MM_Borrowing')
        AND TRADES.bundle_type <> 'PYA' AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRADES.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'PYA'
        AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRADES.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE  = 'StructuredFlows' AND TRADES.EXTERNAL_REFERENCE LIKE 'PYA%' AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN TRADES.PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT
        WHEN TRADES.PRODUCT_TYPE LIKE 'BOND%' AND TRADES.BUNDLE_TYPE = 'ASSET SWAP' AND TRADES.TRADESTATUS = 'VERIFIED' AND TRADES.MATURITY_DATE > LEFT(RIGHT(TRADES.FILE_NAME,12),8) THEN TRADES.NOMINAL END AS TRADE_AMOUNT
    ,TRADES.TRADE_CURRENCY AS CURRENCY
    ,TRADES.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
    from busc.TRY_LEGALENTITY AS LE
        LEFT JOIN busc.TRY_TRADES TRADES
            ON LE.ID = TRADES.COUNTERPARTY_ID
    WHERE TRADES.CounterParty_ID IS NOT NULL AND TRADES.ISACTIVE = 1
    AND LE.ISLATEST = 1 AND LE.ISACTIVE = 1
    AND LE.STATUS = 'ENABLED' AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
)
, TRY_BAL AS
(
SELECT A.[value] AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,CAST(A.TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS varchar(100)) AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,MAX(B.TOTAL_TRADE_AMOUNT) AS BALANCE
    FROM
        (SELECT * FROM TRY_ACC
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(CIF_IDs, '|')
        ) A
    LEFT JOIN
        (SELECT TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER, SUM(TRADE_AMOUNT * ConversionRate) AS TOTAL_TRADE_AMOUNT 
            FROM TRY_ACC 
            LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CurrencyConversion WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01') Z
                ON CAST(TRY_ACC.[TIMESTAMP] AS DATE) = CAST(Z.CurrencyConversionTimestamp AS DATE)
                    AND TRY_ACC.CURRENCY = Z.ConvertFromCurrencyId
            GROUP BY TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER) B
        ON A.TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER = B.TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    GROUP BY A.[value], A.TRY_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
)
, TRY AS
(
    SELECT
    NULL AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,A.[value] AS CUSTOMER_ID
    ,'TRY' AS SOURCE
    ,CAST(LE.ID AS varchar(100)) AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER
    ,LE.LEGAL_ENTITY AS ACCOUNT_NAME
    ,LE.STATUS AS ACCOUNT_STATUS
    ,NULL AS BRANCH_NAME
    ,NULL AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER_TYPE
    ,NULL AS OPENING_DATE
    ,NULL AS CLOSING_DATE
    ,NULL AS AREA
    ,NULL AS REGION
    ,'TRY' AS PRODUCT_CODE
    ,'Treasury' AS PRODUCT_APPLICATION
    ,0 AS DEP_YTD_ADB_PHP
    ,0 AS DEP_OUT_BAL_PHP
    ,0 AS LNS_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS CCD_RELATIONSHIP_EXPOSURE_PHP
    ,0 AS TRUST_FUND_VALUE
    ,TRY_BAL.BALANCE AS TRY_OUTSTANDING_INVESTMENT
    FROM busc.TRY_LEGALENTITY LE
        LEFT JOIN TRY_BAL
            ON LE.ID = TRY_BAL.ACCOUNT_NUMBER
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.TRY_LEGALENTITY 
            CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(EXTERNAL_REF, '|') WHERE isLatest = 1 AND isActive = 1
        ) A
            ON LE.ID = A.ID
    WHERE LE.isLatest = 1 AND LE.isActive = 1 AND LE.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
)
SELECT * FROM DEP
UNION
SELECT * FROM LNS
UNION
SELECT * FROM CCD
UNION
SELECT * FROM TRU
UNION
SELECT * FROM TRY
